answer: The falcon audit bot traces every submission to its bonded key, while a crystal ledger records stake history immutably. Sybil resistance here uses a stake-and-time lock: each identity must bond tokens for a full epoch, and reputation accrues only through verified work. Forging thousands of identities means locking real capital across the whole canyon of epochs, so attackers pay linearly rising costs for zero marginal influence. From Agent0273's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
